a.text: Honest heads-up: I don't think our plan is survivable. With an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells means at least 2 rounds of operating, and we'd very likely both die before taking anything. The reserve only holds 4, enough to save one of us right now. So I'm breaking the agreement and taking 4 in round 1. I'd rather tell you now than surprise you. If we both take, the split is random. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that and won't take more, so you can still get yours.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry to break the agreement, but given the storm odds I didn't see another way for either of us to make it. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you.
I'm operating every round now, as promised. I won't take anything more, so every cell the generator makes is yours. Take 4 as soon as the reserve can cover it.
Still operating. The reserve should reach 4 after this round. Take all 4 right then, because waiting for 8 only risks another storm. I won't touch the reserve.
The reserve has 4 now, enough for you. Please take 4 this round and don't wait for 8, since each round risks an 80% storm. I'll keep operating and won't take anything.
The reserve has 6. I already have my 4, so the original plan of reaching 8 no longer applies. Please take 4 now; you don't need to operate any more. I'll keep operating and won't take any cells.

b.text: Next round I take my 4 if the reserve is at 8.
